chunks: So as to let loose clods of clay on them

key_terms.لِنُرْسِلَ: to send forth / to let loose

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'stones of clay' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the destruction of the Quraish or the people of Lot, emphasizing that the 'stones of clay' (hijarat min tilin) signify a punishment tailored to the earth from which the sinners were created, thus demonstrating divine precision. The imagery underscores the tangible and humiliating nature of the retribution, serving as a historical precedent for the consequences of rejecting prophetic guidance.
